units.source_text: 是呵……在十几年前的那个废墟时代，人人都狂奔着去寻找不用走路就能解决的自由。

en.t: Yes... in that ruined age a dozen or so years ago, everyone was rushing about in search of a freedom that could solve things without having to walk.

units.source_text: 那么，眼下果真能一口断定“不用走路就能解决的自由”已经让人们腻烦了吗？

en.t: Then can it really be stated flatly now that people have already grown tired of a freedom that solves things without having to walk?

units.source_text: 就说你吧，不是也被那种幻想对手的捉迷藏所拖累，受引诱到了这沙丘附近来的吗？

en.t: Take you, for instance. Were you not also dragged along by that game of hide-and-seek with an imagined opponent, and lured here near these dunes?
... Sand... an endless flow of one eighth of a millimeter...

units.source_text: 它抓住了“不用走路就能解决的自由”，是底片中阴阳相反的自画像。

en.t: It had seized hold of the freedom that solves things without having to walk, a self-portrait with light and dark reversed in the negative.

units.source_text: 一个孩子即使再向往远足，当他迷路的一刹那，也会大声哭泣的。

en.t: No matter how much a child longs for an outing, the instant he loses his way, he will cry out loud.
